figures.label: p1
figures.caption: p3357 abstract: DEM in general limited to relative density ~0.8 (existing contact laws); MDEM too time-consuming for many grains; new analytical law from MDEM; DEM of random packings up to ~0.95; local relative density brings incompressibility effects
